how: the page decoded exactly as the reading (same key, same whole-page word decoder with the period French lexicon and data/lexicon-additions.tsv); sense_share = share of signs inside decoded dictionary words of 3 letters or more or a listed short word; bits_per_letter under a period French 5-gram model (lower = more like French); shuffled = the page's signs in random order, seeds 1-3; held_out_last_fifth = the last fifth of the page decoded on its own; without_target_prompted = the reading decoded without the 6 period spellings the target suggested
